risks.risk: Disc may be missing or not included, or disc condition may be poor (scratches/marks).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the inside of the case showing the disc (or proof the disc is included) plus a close-up of the disc surface under light.
risks.if_unproven: Price as case-only / disc unconfirmed (worst case: not working or missing).

risks.risk: Case completeness may be incomplete (missing manual/booklet/inserts).
risks.proof: Photos of everything inside the case laid out (manual/booklet/inserts) and a shot showing the case contents.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete set (worst case: missing inserts/manual).

risks.risk: Original vs copy authenticity may be uncertain (serial/print details not shown).
risks.proof: Photos of the disc hub/inner ring details and any serial/print codes on the case/disc (and back cover).
risks.if_unproven: Price as unverified authenticity (worst case: copy).

risks.risk: Region/compatibility details beyond “PS4” label may not match (e.g., region restrictions).
risks.proof: Photo of the back cover/region/compatibility text and any disc region markings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as compatibility unconfirmed (worst case: may not run).

risks.risk: Physical condition of the case may be worse than the cover suggests (cracks, hinge damage, heavy wear).
risks.proof: Photos of the spine, back cover, and close-ups of hinges/edges for cracks or breaks.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worn/possibly damaged case (worst case: hinge/edge damage).

proof_requests: Show the disc (if included): photo of the disc in the case and a close-up of the disc surface under light.
Show all inserts/manuals inside the case (lay them out and photograph).
Provide photos of the back cover and any serial/print codes (and disc inner ring details).
Show spine/hinges/edges close-ups to confirm the case isn’t cracked or broken.
If claiming a UK receipt, show the receipt photo.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the item as a PS4 game case for “The Witcher Wild Hunt” (PEGI 18) from the cover photos, so it can be priced at its worst case. However, disc inclusion/condition and completeness are not shown, so the price should assume the least favorable scenario until proof is provided.
